description:
Filter and summarize historian rows you supply by tag and time, keeping quality. Does not
        open journals or act on equipment; the HistorianNode records and replays inside a graph.
        Example: query_historian_samples(samples=[{"tag": "flow", "source_time": 1764316800, "value": 12.5, "quality": 0}], tag="flow").

samples.description: Historian rows you supply, each {"tag", "source_time" (seconds), "value", "quality" (integer 0 to 255, 0 good)}.
samples.title: Samples

since.description: Earliest time to include, in seconds (Unix time).
since.title: Since

tag.description: Only rows of this tag; empty for every tag.
tag.title: Tag

until.description: Latest time to include, in seconds (Unix time).
until.title: Until

name: query_historian_samples
title: Filter historian samples
